findings.title: Update on Cybersecurity Event at UNM Health Sciences Center
findings.publisher: University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center (UNM HSC Newsroom)
findings.exact_supporting_passage: All UNM Health hospitals are fully open, ambulance traffic has returned to normal operations, and clinics have resumed regularly scheduled appointments and procedures.
findings.access_consequences: UNM Health states that ambulance transport has returned to normal, all UNM Health hospitals are fully open, and clinics have resumed scheduled appointments and procedures after the October 26 cyber-related diversion and cancellations.
findings.affected_population: Emergency patients transported to UNM Health hospitals and patients with outpatient clinic appointments or procedures in the Albuquerque/Rio Rancho service area; number unknown.
findings.dedupe_note: A distinct October 27 official full-restoration confirmation after the preceding hourly watch; the earlier October 26 cybersecurity disruption and partial resumption notices are not new findings.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall of high-value healthcare access losses/restorations; primary production collection remains authoritative.

cms_public_notices.result: Direct official CMS page check found latest dated entries on October 23 (CA/OH home-health terminations); no new listed provider termination, rescission, CLIA limitation/suspension, or similar notice dated within the observation window.
